result.reason: The redline adds the principal substantive categories but does not reach the preferred or fallback position. It does not expressly require TrueLink to defend, does not limit the added indemnities to third-party claims, and includes no notice, control, or cooperation procedure. It also lacks the fallback IP exclusions, remedies, and 3× annual-fees super-cap, and does not address the required limitation on Client’s indemnity. The changes preserve the original broad breach indemnity, but the drafting is defective and broader than necessary: “any (i) any claim” is ungrammatical, “indemnify and hold Client harmless ... harmless” is duplicative, and indemnifying against any IP “allegation” or any data incident is not tied to a third-party claim.
